abilities.critical_failure: As failure, plus the creature's blood causes fresh growth. A new 10-foot-square patch of lifeleech crystals grows in an adjacent space to the current patch of crystals.
abilities.effect: The crystals twist and slash, animating and cutting into the creature as it walks, dealing 5d8 slashing damage. The creature must attempt a DC 28 Reflex saving throw.
abilities.failure: The creature takes double damage and is drained 2.
abilities.name: Slice Legs
abilities.success: The creature takes full damage and is drained 1.
abilities.trigger: A creature with blood moves through a patch of lifeleech crystals.

hazard.description: Sharp, bloodthirsty crystals make walking through this chamber treacherous.
hazard.disable: Religion DC 30 (expert) to utter prayers that quell the crystals' necromantic compulsion to drink blood
